history.summary: Valid Codex 0.144.1 reasoning, compaction, and image input items are rejected before provider dispatch; docs also overstate npm evidence.
Codex optional fields and id-less compaction continuation pass, but rs1 optional-reasoning carriers are silently dropped by Claude request translation.
All four rs1 request carriers pass, but non-stream Responses reasoning with an empty summary text still loses its opaque carrier.
Aggregate-empty carrier cases pass, but stream/non-stream reasoning diverges on leading whitespace and multi-summary separators.
Framing equivalence passes, but reasoning_text.delta is dropped and missing/duplicate output-item lifecycle can lose or duplicate reasoning while reporting success.
Reasoning lifecycle and bounded-state fixes pass, but valid Codex completed/incomplete terminals without response.status are rejected by the bridge.
Statusless terminals pass, but the bridge still requires response.created.model, accepts terminal id conflicts, and coerces malformed usage to zero.
Terminal identity and usage fixes pass, but malformed required function-call scalars still coerce to empty tool identity and successful Anthropic completion.
Stream scalar validation passes, but non-stream tool-search optional IDs are dropped and malformed function outputs become end_turn success.
Scalar parity and web fixtures pass, but nullable terminal status is over-rejected, full-created web-search snapshots are not reconciled, and raw output variants become empty end_turn success.

Nullable statuses and raw variants now pass, but model-less web snapshots fail, optional usage details and IDs are over-rejected, nested details can conflict silently, and native non-stream nulls are elided.
Web authority and raw-byte forwarding largely pass, but direct Copilot compaction rejects valid id-less output and malformed structured snapshot fields are silently accepted.
Direct compact buffering, native errors, headers, metrics, and authority validation pass, but provider compact skips typed validation/usage metrics and annotation omission can false-conflict.
Direct/provider compact and annotation parity now pass, but malformed web-search request collections are silently filtered or forwarded with invalid shapes.
Web request policy and deferred-reference validation now pass, but undefined tool choices and shallow nested JSON schemas still reach translation/provider paths.
Catalog choices, recursive bounds, boolean schemas, source types, and deferred references pass, but schema primitive semantics and unknown tool-choice/tool fields are still lost or accepted.

Schema semantics, catalog choices, collision checks, and extension preservation mostly pass, but top-level/message extras and stop_sequences are still dropped and empty schema name arrays remain accepted.
